data.exact_reserve_text: In the calendar year there was a prior accident year favourable development of claims incurred of $1.1m. (2014: $6.6m).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 was 121.265 million (USD). Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net gross adverse (strengthening) movement of approximately 7.95 million driven largely by movements in the 2013 underwriting year, although the reported calendar-year narrative records a net (after reinsurance) favourable prior-accident-year development of $1.1m. The discrepancy between the gross adverse movement and the net favourable outcome reflects reinsurance recoveries and movement in the reinsurers' share. No specific named catastrophe events are cited as the driver of this prior-year movement.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross figure was not provided explicitly in a 'movement in prior year's provision' gross column. PYD was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 48) excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2015 and 2014) as per methodology. The report's narrative states a net (after reinsurance) prior-accident-year favourable development of $1.1m; the computed gross PYD (+7.95m) differs from that net figure due to reinsurance recoveries (movement in reinsurers' share). The 'claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' line in the P&L was NOT used (per instructions) because it is a P&L measure, not the movement in prior-year reserves. All amounts are in the report's native currency (USD) and converted to millions. Confidence in the gross PYD is medium (0.8) because it is derived from the triangle rather than an explicit gross movement note.
